requirements.text: The sample(s) of the ESA shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the ESA sample for the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation, and check the marking is clearly legible and indelible after a rub test.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Inspect a production ESA and confirm that the paragraph 5.3 approval mark is affixed to it, unless the ESA is approved only as part of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mark and verify that it shows a circled "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mark and verify that "10R-" and the approval number appear to the right of the circle.

requirements.text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the design and EMC test results to confirm that the ESA, in normal conditions of use, meets the R10 emission and immunity requirements.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Verify that test reports exist for radiated emissions, conducted emissions, radiated immunity and conducted immunity of the ESA.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the broadband radiated emission test report of the lamp uses the Annex 7 method.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 400 MHz; pass if all values are below the Appendix 6 limit line.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz; pass if all values are below 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare all measured broadband emission values with the type approval limits; pass if every value is below the limit.

requirements.text: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the transient conducted emission test on the supply lines uses ISO 7637-2 per Annex 10 against the Table 1 levels.

requirements.text: For positive polarity of pulse amplitude, the maximum allowed pulse amplitude of the transient conducted emission of the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems as specified in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure conducted transient emissions on the supply lines per ISO 7637-2; pass if positive pulses do not exceed +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V).

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the radiated immunity test of the lamp uses a method chosen from Annex 9.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation by the method(s) as described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Check the immunity test report references the Annex 9 method(s) used.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: Verify the applied test level in over 90 % of the band matches Table 2a for the chosen method (e.g. ALSE 30 V/m below 2 GHz, 10 V/m above) with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band is as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify the applied test level never falls below the Table 2b minimum for the chosen method (e.g. ALSE 25 V/m below 2 GHz, 8 V/m above) over the whole band.

requirements.text: Where an ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, the ESA shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.
requirements.test_case: Review the circuit design/BOM for oscillators or switching regulators above 9 kHz; if none, narrowband emission compliance is deemed met.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.test_case: Run the Annex 9 radiated immunity tests and monitor the lamp functions; pass if the immunity related functions (e.g. stop lamp) show no degradation of performance.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows Annex 10 testing per ISO 16750-2 (starting profile) and ISO 7637-2 (pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b) at the Table 3a/3b levels.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply 500 pulses of ISO 7637-2 pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V) / -450 V (24 V); pass if FPSC III is achieved for all functions.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V) / -150 V (24 V) for 1 h; pass if immunity related functions achieve FPSC I and other functions FPSC III.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the starting profile results are evaluated and reported using the ISO 16750-1 functional status classes.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Verify the pulse 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b results are classified using the ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply starting profile level II (12 V) for 10 pulses and verify the lamp reaches status B (immunity-related functions, if operational during start), D (non-immunity-related) or C (other ESA).

requirements.text: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp circuit for switches and inductive loads; if none, transient conducted emission compliance with paragraph 6.7 is deemed met, otherwise test.

requirements.text: Components or ESAs approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7.
requirements.test_case: Test series-production samples against the paragraph 6 emission and immunity requirements and confirm they match the approved type.

requirements.text: If the Type Approval Authority is not satisfied with the checking procedure of the manufacturer, when the conformity of a component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. for ESAs (as appropriate).
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband and narrowband radiated emissions of a series-production ESA per Annexes 7 and 8 and confirm levels are no more than 4 dB above the paragraph 6.5.2.1 and 6.6.2.1 limits.

requirements.text: If the Type Approval Authority is not satisfied with the checking procedure of the manufacturer, when the conformity of a component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs.
requirements.test_case: Expose a series-production ESA to radiated fields up to 80 % of the paragraph 6.8.2.1 levels per Annex 9 and confirm no observable degradation of the lamp functions.

requirements.text: If the Type Approval Authority is not satisfied with the checking procedure of the manufacturer, when the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses per paragraph 6.9.1 and measure conducted emissions per paragraph 6.7.1 on a series-production sample; confirm no degradation of immunity-related functions and emissions within limits.

requirements.text: In the 30-75 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit shall be E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA radiated broadband emissions per Annex 7 with a 120 kHz bandwidth in 30-75 MHz; pass if all readings are at or below 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the 75-400 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit shall be E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA radiated broadband emissions with a 120 kHz bandwidth in 75-400 MHz; pass if all readings are at or below 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit shall be E = 63 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA radiated broadband emissions with a 120 kHz bandwidth in 400-1,000 MHz; pass if all readings are at or below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the 30-75 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit shall be E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA radiated narrowband emissions per Annex 7 with a 120 kHz bandwidth in 30-75 MHz; pass if all readings are at or below 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the 75-400 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit shall be E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA radiated narrowband emissions with a 120 kHz bandwidth in 75-400 MHz; pass if all readings are at or below 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit shall be E = 53 dBµV/m for a 120 kHz bandwidth (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA radiated narrowband emissions with a 120 kHz bandwidth in 400-1,000 MHz; pass if all readings are at or below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test of broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs shall be performed according CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report to confirm the radiated broadband emission test was performed according to CISPR 25.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test plan/report that the lamp was operated in normal operation mode with all functions (position, stop, reversing) at maximum load during the measurement.

requirements.text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report confirms the ALSE set-up per CISPR 25 Clause 6.4 was used for the lamp.

requirements.text: To ensure that there is no extraneous noise or signal of a magnitude sufficient to affect materially the measurement, ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main test.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report contains an ambient scan taken before or after the main lamp emission test.

requirements.text: In the ambient measurement, the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
requirements.test_case: Compare the ambient scan with the paragraph 6.5.2.1 limits; pass if ambient is at least 6 dB below the limits except intentional narrowband transmissions.

requirements.text: The limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Measure radiated broadband emissions of the lamp from 30 to 1,000 MHz in ALSE/OATS; pass if emissions are below the limits over the whole range.

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used for the measurements, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied to the limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation, which are for quasi-peak detectors.
requirements.test_case: Check the Annex 7 test report: where peak detection is used, verify the 20 dB CISPR 12 correction was applied to the quasi-peak limits.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load, during the narrowband emission tests.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test plan and report that all lamp functions were operated in normal mode at maximum load during the measurement.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25, except that as an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used (see Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report documents an ALSE set-up per CISPR 25 paragraph 6.4 or a CISPR 16-1-4 compliant OATS.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Check the receiver settings in the report show the average detector was used.

requirements.text: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Review the test plan and reports to confirm the chosen ISO 11452 methods together cover the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range.

requirements.text: The test conditions shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report records test conditions conforming to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on.
requirements.test_case: Confirm in the test setup record that the lamp was powered during the immunity test.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the position, stop and reversing functions were activated in normal operating mode during exposure.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the test arrangement photos/records against Annex 9 and the applicable ISO 11452 part.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 frequency steps.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the report shows AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth used from 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the report shows PM2 (Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs) used from 2,700 to 3,100 MHz.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check the report shows PM3 (Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs) used in 380-2,700 MHz and 3,100-6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify step size and dwell time in the report against ISO 11452-1 values.

requirements.text: In the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
requirements.test_case: Check the absorber chamber report states field calibration by the substitution method per ISO 11452-2.

requirements.text: The absorber chamber test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.test_case: Verify the antenna polarization recorded in the absorber chamber test report is vertical.

requirements.text: When TEM cell testing is used, the immunity test of the ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
requirements.test_case: Review the TEM cell immunity test report and confirm the test was performed per ISO 11452-3 with the ESA meeting the required test levels.

requirements.text: When bulk current injection testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA; or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Review the BCI test report and confirm testing per ISO 11452-4 with the injection probe at 150 mm (substitution) or 900 mm (closed loop) from the ESA.

requirements.text: When stripline testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
requirements.test_case: Review the stripline immunity test report and confirm the test was performed per ISO 11452-5.

requirements.text: When reverberation chamber testing is used, the test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Review the reverberation chamber test report and confirm the test was performed per ISO 11452-11.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the lamp supply lines and operationally connected lines and verify the required FPSC is met.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the lamp supply lines (unless exclusively for electric vehicles) and verify the required functional status class is achieved.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient conducted emissions of the lamp per ISO 7637-2 on supply and operationally connected lines and verify results are within the regulation limits.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp mounting on the vehicle and, after vibration exposure under normal conditions of use, verify the lamp's position, photometric and visibility characteristics remain compliant with R48.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp fixing and fasteners on the vehicle to confirm the lamp cannot be moved out of its installed orientation without deliberate action or tools.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed lamp's reference axis on the vehicle and confirm it is parallel to the road bearing plane within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of all signalling devices other than side retro-reflectors and side-marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed lamp's reference axis in plan view and confirm it is parallel to the vehicle median longitudinal plane within ±3°.

requirements.text: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed for the orientation of the reference axis of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Check that the measured deviation of the reference axis in each direction does not exceed ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of the light-signalling devices laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installation on the vehicle against the manufacturer's fitting instructions and confirm conformity.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.test_case: Verify lamp height and orientation with the unladen vehicle on a flat horizontal surface in the condition of paragraphs 2.3.10 to 2.3.10.2.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Measure left and right lamp positions relative to the median longitudinal plane based on the exterior form and confirm symmetry.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement not being valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the exterior geometry of the left and right lamps and confirm they are mirror-symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function on left and right lamps and confirm both meet the same colour requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric measurements of left and right lamps for each function and confirm they are substantially identical.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo shall be permitted to be fitted on the rear of the vehicle and only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo shall be permitted to be fitted on the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle rear and count logos in lamps; confirm at most two lateral (one per side) or one central logo.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any logo in the lamp and confirm it is a vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical the requirements of paragraphs 5.5. to 5.5.5. for lamps constituting a pair shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: For an asymmetrical vehicle, review the lamp pair installation and confirm symmetry requirements are met as far as possible.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: For each function of the combination lamp, verify colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connection requirements are individually met.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry and colour of each function (position, stop, reversing) with all other functions switched off and confirm compliance.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the rear position lamp together with the reciprocally incorporated function and measure the colour of that function; confirm compliance.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Project the distinct parts along the reference axis and compute the ratio to the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral; pass if at least 60 % (or alternative (b) is met).

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that, as an alternative to subparagraph (a), the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts perpendicular to the reference axis; pass if not more than 75 mm (or alternative (a) is met).

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify per paragraph 5.10.4.1 that the red rear lamp apparent surfaces are not directly visible from Zone 1, 25 m in front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface along the reference axis above ground and compare with the height limits.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each lamp function on the vehicle and confirm intensity, colour and apparent surface remain constant while switched ON, absent a specific provision allowing variation.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry at each ambient-light-dependent intensity state and confirm every state meets the lamp's technical provisions.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp with other lamps switched ON and OFF and confirm each state complies with the lamp's technical provisions.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure the shared lamp in each function mode and confirm compliance with the technical provisions of each function.

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Sight check or CAD line-of-sight analysis from Zone 1 at 25 m in front of the vehicle shows no direct view of the red rear position/stop lamp apparent surfaces.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement of paragraph 5.10.4.1 shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp type-approval photometric report: red light intensity emitted forwards is at most 0.25 cd per lamp, considering vehicle body influence.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lighting switch on the vehicle and confirm the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF only together with the front position, side-marker, end-outline and registration plate lamps.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Activate the function and confirm all light sources of the interdependent lamp system switch ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and confirm the rear position, stop, reversing lamps and retro-reflector are not concealable by any cover or mechanism.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the reversing lamp light and confirm they fall within the white colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the stop lamp light and confirm they fall within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the rear position lamp light and confirm they fall within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector under standard illuminant and confirm it is within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors fitted on the vehicle and compare against the numbers in the individual specifications.

requirements.text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Where the lamp is on a movable component, verify compliance with paragraphs 5.18, 5.19 and 5.20.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: With the movable component in each fixed position, measure position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the lamps and confirm all requirements are met.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: With the movable component open, assess the lamps installed on it for glare or undue discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Open and close the movable component repeatedly and verify that the lamp returns to the manufacturer-specified position each time.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: With the movable component in each manufacturer-specified fixed position, measure the hidden share of the apparent surface along the reference axis; pass if not more than 50 %.

requirements.text: Lamps approved with light source(s) according to UN Regulation No. 37, except when such light sources are used as non-replaceable light source(s) as defined in paragraph 2.9.1.2., shall be fitted in a vehicle in such a way that the light source can be correctly replaced without the need for expert assistance and without the need for special tools, other than those provided with the vehicle by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Replace the light source on the vehicle using only vehicle-supplied tools and without expert help; pass if replacement is correct.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., shall be allowed, provided that the intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Vary the controlling conditions and measure intensities of all variable lamps; pass if they vary together in the same manner and similar proportion.

requirements.text: For rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop/position intensity ratio across the full variation range and transitions; pass if the prescribed ratio is maintained.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved, except that this shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage on the vehicle at constant voltage operation; pass if it does not exceed the approved voltage.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except that this shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage at each function on the vehicle at constant voltage operation; pass if ≤ 13.5 V +3 % (12 V system) or the corresponding value.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, check over the full angles of geometric visibility that no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface (obstacles present at lamp type approval excepted).

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.test_case: Review the geometric visibility measurement set-up and confirm that near-field observations use parallel-shifted directions of observation.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Where masking occurs, measure photometry of the lamp with the vehicle masking reproduced and confirm the values prescribed for device approval are met.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify the geometric visibility angles are met.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the lamp carries valid approval marks under the device regulations (R148 for position/stop/reversing, R150 for retro-reflector).

requirements.text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: If a logo is incorporated, confirm the lamp holds an R148 approval covering the logo.

requirements.text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect fitted light sources and confirm each carries approval for the category stated in the lamp approval.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle and confirm that at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

requirements.text: One reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.test_case: Count the reversing lamps installed on the M1 vehicle; pass if there are one or two devices.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the reversing lamp approval certificate and marking; pass if it shows approval to UN R23 or UN R148 (00 or later series).

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be at a height of not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the reversing lamp apparent surface above the ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if it is between 250 mm and 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle, except that if installed, the two optional devices mentioned in paragraph 6.4.2.2. may be fitted on the side of the vehicle, provided that the requirements of paragraphs 6.4.5.2. and 6.4.6.2. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation; pass if the reversing lamp is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle (or by CAD) that the reversing lamp apparent surface is unobstructed within α = 15° up/5° down and β = 45° right/left (one device) or 45° outwards/30° inwards (two devices).

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp; pass if the reference axis of the reversing lamp points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on vehicle: engage reverse with propulsion system operable and confirm the lamp lights; confirm it cannot be lit otherwise.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test: with the lamp lit, disengage reverse and separately switch the propulsion system off; pass if the lamp switches OFF in each case and does not light when either condition is absent.

requirements.text: The tell-tale for the reversing lamp shall be optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component regulation (R148) and vehicle wiring: if failure indication is required for the reversing lamp, verify that a failure tell-tale is fitted and activates on lamp failure.

requirements.text: Devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and confirm that S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check that the stop lamp carries a valid UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 approval mark and has the corresponding approval certificate.

requirements.text: All categories of vehicles shall be equipped with two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device.
requirements.test_case: Count the stop lamps installed on the vehicle and confirm there are exactly two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge on the vehicle and confirm it is ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the stop lamp apparent surface above the ground on the unladen vehicle and confirm it lies between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified by the bodywork).

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm that the stop lamps are installed at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility for S1 or S2 categories devices shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed lamp, by CAD or a goniometric check, that the apparent surface is unobstructed over 45° inboard and outboard (or 20° inboard under the H plane if the lamp is mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility for S1 or S2 categories devices shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed lamp, by CAD or a visibility check, that the apparent surface is unobstructed over 15° up and 15° down (or 5° down if the lamp is mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm that the stop lamp reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the service brake on the vehicle and confirm that all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device, which starts and/or stops the propulsion system, is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
requirements.test_case: With the propulsion start/stop device in the off position, check whether the stop lamps operate and confirm that any behaviour observed is permitted.

requirements.text: The tell-tale for stop lamps shall be optional, except that a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the component approval; if it requires failure indication, simulate a stop lamp failure and confirm that the tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle lighting installation and the approval markings to confirm that rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface in the reference axis direction to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if it is not more than 400 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation to confirm that the rear position lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify an unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 45° inwards and 80° outwards (20° inwards under the H plane if the lamp is mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify an unobstructed view of the apparent surface over 15° above and 15° below the horizontal (5° downward if the lamp is mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric/installation check on the vehicle that the rear position lamp is visible from 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under H plane if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the installed lamp visibility over 15° above and below the horizontal (5° downward if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, when the alternative of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, to be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light being excluded.
requirements.test_case: Measure the unobstructed projected apparent surface (excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area) within the visibility angles; pass if ≥ 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect installation drawing/vehicle to confirm the reference axis of the rear position lamp points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review wiring diagram and functional test that rear position lamps switch with front position lamps, end-outline and rear registration plate lamps per 5.11.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be mandatory, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the rear position lamps and verify that a closed-circuit tell-tale is lit on the instrument panel.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Verify by inspection that the same tell-tale indicates both front and rear position lamps.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component regulation; if required, simulate lamp failure and verify the failure tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle rear and confirm that non-triangular rear retro-reflectors are fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear retro-reflectors on the vehicle (two) and check that each carries a Class IA or IB approval mark under R3 (02 series or later) or R150.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4.) shall be permitted provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Where additional retro-reflecting devices are fitted, verify by inspection that they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.

requirements.text: The point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the lateral distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if it is ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height above ground of the retro-reflector at unladen condition; pass if it is between 250 mm and 900 mm (≤ 1,200 mm when grouped with rear lamps, ≤ 1,500 mm if bodywork shape prevents it).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the retro-reflector illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and 30° outwards horizontally.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the retro-reflector is unobstructed over 10° up and 10° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm per paragraph 5.8.1).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that the retro-reflector reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be permitted to have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp drawing to identify any overlap between the retro-reflector illuminating surface and other rear lamp apparent surfaces and confirm the overlapping lamps are rear lamps.

requirements.text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON, except that the rear position lamps and the other lamp(s) mentioned in paragraph 5.11. may be switched OFF when the daytime running lamps are switched ON, and may remain switched OFF as long as the ambient light conditions outside vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, switch on the daytime running lamps and verify the rear position lamps are ON, or are OFF only while measured ambient light per Annex 13 exceeds 7,000 lux.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal on the vehicle and verify that all fitted stop lamps (or all direction-indicator lamps) operate simultaneously.

requirements.text: All the lamps of the emergency stop signal shall flash in phase at a frequency of 4.0 ± 1.0 Hz.
requirements.test_case: Activate the emergency stop signal and measure the flash frequency and phase of all lamps; pass if all flash in phase at 3.0 to 5.0 Hz.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the values measured for the distances of the position of lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured mounting distances of each rear lamp function on production vehicles against the individual installation specifications; pass if all are within the limits.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Measure visibility angles of each rear lamp function on production vehicles; pass if they meet the individual specifications within the ±3° mounting allowance.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On a production vehicle, check that red light from the rear lamp is not visible from the front and white light (other than the reversing lamp) is not visible from the rear per paragraph 5.10; pass if compliant.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Operate each rear lamp function and associated tell-tales on a production vehicle; pass if switching behaviour meets paragraphs 5.11-5.14 and individual lamp specifications.

requirements.text: For control of conformity of production, the presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare observed lamp presence, number, colour (red position/stop, white reversing, red retro-reflector), arrangement and category markings against paragraphs 5.15, 5.16 and individual specifications; pass if all conform.

requirements.text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify by test reports that the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp in the combination unit each individually meet the provisions of UN R148 (or of another applicable Regulation, e.g. UN R150 for the retro-reflector).

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the bill of functions of the combination unit and confirm that every lamp function it contains is covered by a passing assessment against an applicable Regulation; no unapproved lamp function is present.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device drawing and sample to confirm a marking space large enough for the approval marking and all other required markings.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the markings for legibility and perform a rub/durability test to confirm they remain legible and are not removed.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for “a” shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the dimension "a" of the approval marking on the device and confirm it is at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm a circle surrounding the letter E followed by the distinguishing number of the approving country.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm the four to six-digit sequential number from the approval number is present.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking layout and confirm the sequential number is placed close to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm the symbols of all approved functions (e.g. R1/R2, S1/S2, AR) are present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm "148R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments in force at approval.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall consist of a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: For handed lamps, inspect the marking for a horizontal arrow indicating the mounting position.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of front or rear position lamps, front or rear end-outline marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp in its mounted orientation, confirm the horizontal arrow on the rear position lamp points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of reversing lamps in case of reduced light distribution of two reversing lamps.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp in its mounted orientation, confirm the horizontal arrow for the reversing lamp points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: If applicable, the approval marking shall consist of, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "D", on lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm the letter D to the right of the function symbol where the lamp is part of an assembly of two independent lamps.

requirements.text: If applicable, the approval marking shall consist of, to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4., the additional letter "Y", on lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm the letter Y to the right of the function symbol where the lamp is part of an interdependent lamps system.

requirements.text: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, the approval marking shall consist of a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: For lamps with reduced light distribution, inspect the marking for a downward vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the production lamp and confirm the approval marking is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and confirm the applicant's trade name or mark is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: For lamps with replaceable light sources, inspect the lamp for a marking of the prescribed light source category(ies).

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, in the case where the lamp has been approved for LED substitute light source(s), bear a marking indicating also the category or categories of the LED substitute light source(s).
requirements.test_case: For lamps approved for LED substitute light sources, inspect the lamp for a marking of the LED substitute light source category(ies).

requirements.text: Lamps with non-replaceable light sources shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a rated voltage or voltage-range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: Lamps with an electronic light source control gear shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a rated voltage (6V/12V/24V) or voltage-range marking; pass if present and legible.

requirements.text: Lamps with a variable luminous intensity control shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a rated voltage or voltage-range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each replaceable module for the applicant's trade name or mark; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the specific identification code of the module.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each replaceable module for its specific identification code; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the specific identification code of the module shall comprise the starting letters “MD” for “MODULE” followed by the approval mark without the circle as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.2.1.1., in case several non-identical light source modules are used, followed by additional symbols or characters.
requirements.test_case: Check the module code starts with 'MD' followed by the approval mark without circle (plus extra characters for non-identical modules); pass if format matches.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the light source module(s) shall bear the rated voltage(s) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each module for rated voltage or voltage-range marking; pass if present.

requirements.text: In case replaceable light source module(s) is/are used, the lamp shall bear the specific identification code of the module as prescribed in paragraph 3.3.3.5. (a), (ii).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for the module identification code; pass if present and matching the module.

requirements.text: An electronic light source control gear or variable luminous intensity control being part of the lamp, but not included into the lamp body, shall be marked with its identification number and the name of the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the external control gear for identification number and manufacturer name; pass if both present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking location; pass if on a part not designed to be separated from the light-emitting lens.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, check the approval marking is visible directly or after opening a movable part; pass if visible.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: Inspect detachable lens and main body; pass if both carry the approval marking.

requirements.text: In case an outer lens is used for several devices and bearing different approval markings, the main body of each device shall bear only the approval marking of the function(s) of that device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect each device main body; pass if it carries only the approval marking of its own function(s).

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
