requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp; pass if the approval marking and the applicable markings of 3.3.3.2 to 3.3.3.6 are affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations and a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number is affixed, this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps only provided that it is visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed, check the single approval mark is visible; pass if visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to remove light-transmitting parts; pass if none can be removed without also removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark; pass if not smaller than the smallest minimum size required by the pertinent Regulations.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report for the lamp; pass if all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5 are met.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp against sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 (M1 vehicle) in force at application; pass if all applicable provisions are met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check that the R48 provisions for rear position, stop and reversing lamps on M1 vehicles that are verifiable at lamp approval have been verified; pass if all are met.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the design and, after vibration/durability exposure, measure photometry and colour; pass if the lamp operates satisfactorily and still meets the prescribed characteristics.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall either be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source), or be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the light source configuration and communication document; pass if the functions use multiple light sources or the lamp is declared for vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the stop and reversing lamp optics and lens areas; pass if no logo is incorporated.

requirements.text: On request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled and the conditions of paragraph 4.5.5. (a) to (d) are met.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for logos; pass if at most one logo is present and the function still meets all photometric and colour requirements.

requirements.text: When a logo is incorporated in the apparent surface of a lamp (function), irrespective of the marking requirements in paragraph 3.3., only the logo of the brand name of the vehicle manufacturer or the body manufacturer shall be allowed.
requirements.test_case: Compare the logo with the vehicle/body manufacturer brand and applicant statement; pass if it is the brand logo only.

requirements.text: When a logo is incorporated in the apparent surface of a lamp (function), the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the projected logo surface in the reference axis direction; pass if ≤ 100 cm2.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the LED wiring schematic; pass if series-wired LED groups are treated as one light source in the failure analysis.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) the light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) a signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of each light source/group and measure photometry per Annex 3 (and maximum with all on), or verify the failure tell-tale signal is produced; pass if one option is met.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure intensity; pass if steady luminous intensity requirements of the category are automatically met.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and BOM; pass if all light sources are R37/R99/R128 approved replaceable sources, light source modules or non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit the light source in alternative orientations; pass if it can only be fixed in the correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying, and where a category of LED substitute light source(s) is also prescribed, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of LED substitute light source(s) applying.
requirements.test_case: Gauge the holder against the IEC 60061 data sheet(s) for the prescribed category; pass if dimensions conform.

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform radiated and conducted emission assessment (e.g. per UN R10) on the vehicle/lamp; pass if no malfunction of other vehicle electronic systems is caused.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt fitting in other positions and removal without tools; pass if only correct fitting is possible and removal requires a tool.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module design for tamper resistance; pass if module cannot be opened or modified without visible damage.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source and/or any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to interchange the module with UN approved light sources and other modules in the housing; pass if not possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another bearing the same identification code and repeat photometry; pass if requirements are met.

requirements.text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraphs 4.8.1.1. to 4.8.1.10. (Particulars of the methods of measurement to be used are given in Annex 3).
requirements.test_case: Review test report; pass if photometric and colorimetric measurements follow the stated conditions and Annex 3 methods.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check test report; pass if measurements were made with the lamp's own light sources fitted.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined.
requirements.test_case: Determine and document the apparent surface limits along the reference axis for each function; pass if recorded in the test report.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Measure supply voltage at the lamp terminals during tests; pass if 6.75 V, 13.5 V or 28 V as applicable.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Review test conditions; pass if the lamp was operated per the applicant's specification.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Review test conditions; pass if the lamp was operated per the applicant's specification.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement at HV for each function on both samples; pass if intensity is at or above the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan all visible directions on both samples; pass if no measured intensity exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum for the function.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure each grid point of the Annex 3 light distribution figure; pass if every point meets the percentage of the minimum or the specified intensity value.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities across the Annex 2 geometric visibility angles; pass if all are at or above the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate the measured light distribution against the Annex 3 local variation provisions; pass if no prohibited local variation occurs.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone shall be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table, where, if one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.test_case: Measure combined stop+position and position-only intensities in ±5° V, ±10° H; pass if ratio is at least 5:1 at every point.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report; pass if luminous intensity tests follow the Annex 8 procedure.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Perform colorimetric measurement within the Annex 3 grid for each function (red and white); pass if chromaticity is within the specified limits.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visually/colorimetrically inspect beyond the grid field; pass if no sharp colour change is observed.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied, except that for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Confirm colour measurements used paragraph 4.8 conditions (with the built-in LEDs if non-replaceable).

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of rear position lamps supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 4, except that a luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples per Annex 3; all points within Table 4 limits (max raised to 60 cd below 5° down only if reciprocally incorporated with the stop lamp).

requirements.text: For category R1 (steady) rear position lamps, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4∙10^0 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.7∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp and 8.5∙10^0 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 the minimum luminous intensity shall be 5∙10^-2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometric test of both samples: H-V minimum 4 cd, maximum 17 cd (8.5 cd if marked D), Figure A3-I distribution met, ≥0.05 cd throughout Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of the rear position lamps within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at the boundary and within the Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles; all values ≥ 0.05 cd.

requirements.text: The failure provisions for rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Review design and test the lamp with simulated light source failure per paragraph 4.6; behaviour meets those provisions.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light; chromaticity coordinates within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the stop lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity and light distribution of both stop lamp samples on a goniophotometer and confirm all Table 7 values for the declared category are met.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), a maximum luminous intensity of 2.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 1.30∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10^-1 cd within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples: reference-axis intensity at least 60 cd, no value above 260 cd (130 cd if marked D), Figure A3-I distribution met and at least 0.3 cd throughout the Table A2-1 visibility angles.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), a maximum luminous intensity of 7.30∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 3.65∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10^-1 cd (day) or 7∙10^-2 cd (night) within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples in day and night modes: reference-axis intensity at least 60 cd, no value above 730 cd (365 cd if marked D), Figure A3-I distribution met and at least 0.3 cd (day) / 0.07 cd (night) within the Table A2-1 visibility angles.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall comply with the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Simulate light source failure on the stop lamp and verify behaviour against the paragraph 4.6 provisions.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity coordinates of the stop lamp light with a spectroradiometer and confirm they lie within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the reversing lamp shall meet the luminous intensity and standard light distribution requirements in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity distribution of both reversing lamp samples on a goniophotometer and confirm all Table 10 values are met.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps of category AR, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 8.0∙101 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 3.00∙102 cd in or above the h-plane, 6.00∙102 cd below the h-plane down to 5°D and 8.00∙103 cd below 5°D (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), and the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-V (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), as specified in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement: minimum ≥80 cd per Figure A3-V and maxima ≤300 cd at/above h-plane, ≤600 cd down to 5°D, ≤8000 cd below 5°D.

requirements.text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reversing lamp intensity at 30° inwards and confirm at least 25 cd.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of the reversing lamp light and confirm they lie within the white colour boundaries.

requirements.text: Outside of the projection area as defined by the individual specifications of UN Regulation No. 48, the light of the reversing lamp emitted directly towards the rear of the vehicle shall not exceed 5∙10-1 cd within the angular field defined by the vertical minimum angle φmin (in degrees) = arctan ((1-h)/10), where h is mounting height in m, and the vertical maximum angle φmax (in degrees) = φmin + 11.3.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of the reversing lamp outside the R48 projection area within φmin to φmax computed from the mounting height; pass if every value ≤ 5∙10-1 cd.

requirements.text: The measurement of the light of the reversing lamp emitted directly towards the rear of the vehicle shall be limited to a horizontal angle ranging from +90° to -90° with respect to the line which cuts the reference axis and which is perpendicular to the vertical transversal plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows the rearward glare measurement performed over horizontal angles from +90° to -90° about the stated line.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: CoP audit comparing production lamps with the approved type documentation; pass if no deviation.

requirements.text: No measured value of the produced lamps shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of production samples; pass if no value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the prescribed values.

requirements.text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3 the measured values of the produced lamps shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Compare production sample minimum-field measurements with the Table 12 equivalent values.

requirements.text: The front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2) shall have minimum angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard horizontally (20°/80°, reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm) and 15° above / 15° below vertically (15°/5° for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm; 5°/15° for optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm), as specified in Table A2-1, the angles shown being correct for lamps to be mounted on the right side of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric check of the rear position lamp verifying the light-emitting surface is visible and photometric minima are met over 45°/80° horizontal and 15°/15° vertical (or reduced angles per mounting height).

requirements.text: Unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, and the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometric evaluation: the per-direction minimum values derived from Figures A3-I and A3-V percentages are rounded down to three significant digits.

requirements.text: Within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer scan of each lamp function between grid points; every intermediate direction must be at least the lowest minimum value of the surrounding grid points.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the reversing lamp beam; where local variations appear, measure between adjacent measuring directions and confirm no value is below 50 % of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I, the values shown giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position lamp intensities at all Figure A3-I points; each must be at least the stated percentage of the minimum intensity required in Table 3.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall meet the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V, the values shown in figure A3-V giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities in cd.
requirements.test_case: Measure reversing lamp intensities at each Figure A3-V measuring point relative to the reference axis; each value must be at least the minimum in cd shown.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare mechanical and geometric features of production lamps with the approved type; pass if differences stay within inevitable manufacturing deviations and the Regulation's requirements.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested, when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometric performance of a randomly chosen production lamp per paragraph 4.8; pass if results meet the paragraph 4.8 conformity criteria.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of red and white functions of production lamps under paragraph 4.9 conditions; pass if coordinates lie within the specified colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
requirements.test_case: Inspect randomly sampled production lamps against the approved drawings and confirm that mechanical and geometric differences stay within inevitable manufacturing deviations.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random, no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the photometric performance of a randomly chosen production lamp per paragraph 4.8 for each function and confirm that no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3.

requirements.text: The conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent, except that in the case that the deviation of both lamps of sample A is not more than 0 per cent the measurement can be terminated.
requirements.test_case: Measure the four randomly selected lamps (samples A and B) and confirm that no specimen deviates by more than 20 per cent from the prescribed photometric values.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the reversing lamp and measure luminous intensities after 1 min and 10 min; all values must lie within the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: For all other lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the rear position and stop lamps and measure luminous intensities after 1 min and after 30 min (or photometric stability); all values must lie within the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the rear position lamp shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure or calculate the rear position lamp intensity distribution 4 s after switch ON using the HV ratio; values must comply with the limits.

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm LED-only technology for each function and that the paragraph 1.2 measurements comply; then no additional time-point testing is needed.

requirements.text: The approval number assigned to each type approved shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector sample; pass if the assigned approval number is marked on the device in the manner required by paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) shall be IA, with a minimum "a" of 5 mm for examples of figures in Annex 10, as specified in paragraph 5.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the device and verify the class symbol reads "IA" and character height a is at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight) shall be IB, with a minimum "a" of 5 mm for examples of figures in Annex 10, as specified in paragraph 5.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the device and verify the class symbol reads "IB" and character height a is at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the device drawing/sample and verify a marking space large enough for the UI or approval marking and other markings per 3.3.4.2 is provided.

requirements.text: The markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually check legibility of all markings and perform a rub/durability test; markings must remain legible and intact.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking, the value for "a" shall be as defined in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval marking dimensions and verify a is not less than the Table 1 value (5 mm for classes IA/IB).

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify a circle surrounding "E" followed by the approving country's number is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the four to six-digit sequential number of the approval number is present.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking layout and verify the sequential number is adjacent to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the class symbol (e.g. IA or IB) per Table 1 is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R" and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify "150R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments is present.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I Unique Identifier (UI).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector marking and confirm the UI mark matches the Figure I format.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective devices shall bear the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check whether rotation angle is ambiguous; if so verify 'TOP' is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the device and confirm the approval mark/UI and trade name/TOP markings are clearly legible.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed, and this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that the conditions of paragraphs 3.3.6.1.1. and 3.3.6.1.2. are met.
requirements.test_case: Review marking drawing to confirm single approval mark covers all applicable regulations and meets location provisos.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the single approval mark shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Install the lamp on the vehicle and confirm the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Inspect design to confirm the mark is on a part (e.g. lens) whose removal also removes every light-transmitting part.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark and compare against the smallest minimum size required by the pertinent regulations.

requirements.text: Retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Test production samples against paragraphs 4 and 5 and confirm conformity with the approved type.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the retro-reflector against the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 in force at application; pass if all feasible requirements are met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check that the R48 requirements pertinent to the rear retro-reflector for M1 vehicles that are verifiable at device approval are assessed and met.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect design and test results; pass if the retro-reflector functions satisfactorily before and after the prescribed tests.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect samples; pass if no design or manufacturing defect affecting operation or maintenance is found.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector by hand without tools; pass if components cannot be easily separated.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer lens surface over the retro-reflector; pass if it can be cleaned easily.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Visually and tactilely inspect the outer surface; pass if not rough and protuberances do not hinder cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the assembled lamp; pass if the inner (prism) surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.

requirements.text: The combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to separate optical unit and filter under normal conditions of use; pass if they cannot be separated.

requirements.text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish shall not be permitted.
requirements.test_case: Review BOM and inspect the optic/filter; pass if colour is obtained by tinted material, not paint or varnish.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of retro-reflected light; pass if x,y lie within the R48 red night-time colour limits.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Verify the colorimetric test set-up uses Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence and β1=β2=0° (or Annex 4 angle).

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure retro-reflector dimensions and shape; pass if compliant with Annex 5 (e.g. non-triangular, size limits).

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure CIL and colour per 5.1.4 to 5.1.5; pass if all values meet the specified limits.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Perform the 5.1.7 physical and mechanical test sequence; pass if all requirements are met.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Run the Annex 6 Part 1 heat test on ten retro-reflector samples, then after at least 1 h measure colour and RI at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; samples must comply with 5.1.5 and 5.1.4.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: After the group tests, measure the night-time colour of each sample; the chromaticity must lie within the R48 red limits.

requirements.text: The verification of the RI of the retro-reflectors after undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1. shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the post-test RI at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0°; the value must be at least 300 mcd/lx for red.

requirements.text: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.
requirements.test_case: Check that the approval documentation defines the axis of reference corresponding to β1 = β2 = 0°.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered.
requirements.test_case: Verify that the illuminating surface used for photometry lies within a 200 mm diameter circle.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, the illuminating surface of the retro-reflective device of Class IA or IB shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.test_case: Measure the illuminating surface area used for photometry; it must not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and Class IB shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1 paragraph 3 at all Table 3 angles; each value must be at least the Table 3 minimum.

requirements.text: For Class IA and IB red retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence α of 20', the RI values shall be equal to or greater than 3.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°, 2.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° and 1.00∙10^2 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°, as specified in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric RI measurement at 20' divergence; the values must be at least 300, 200 and 100 mcd/lx at the respective angles.

requirements.text: For Class IA and IB red retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence α of 1°30', the RI values shall be equal to or greater than 5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°, 2.8∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° and 2.5∙10^0 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°, as specified in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric RI measurement at 1°30' divergence; the values must be at least 5, 2.8 and 2.5 mcd/lx at the respective angles.

requirements.text: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 shall not be permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Scan RI within the bounded solid angle; no value may fall below the applicable Table 3 minimum.

requirements.text: In the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: If the mounting height is below 750 mm, verify RI downward angles only to 5°; the values must meet Table 3.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Check that the night-time colour test report follows the method of paragraph 4.2.1.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reflected light; the x,y coordinates must lie within the R48 night-time red boundaries.

requirements.text: The retro-reflectors of Classes IA and IB shall be tested in the chronological order of tests given in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm samples a to j were tested in the Table 4 sequence.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure dimensions and geometry of production retro-reflectors and confirm deviations stay within inevitable manufacturing deviations and the Regulation's requirements.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall not be contested if, when testing photometric performances of any retro-reflective device chosen at random no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically test randomly chosen production retro-reflectors; pass if no measured CIL value is more than 20 per cent below the prescribed minimum values.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of production retro-reflectors and confirm the coordinates lie within the prescribed red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
requirements.test_case: Compare dimensions and mechanical features of production retro-reflectors against the approved type; pass if differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflective devices shall not be contested if, when testing photometric performances of any retro-reflective device chosen at random, no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Regulation, except that retro-reflective devices with apparent defects are disregarded.
requirements.test_case: Measure CIL values of randomly chosen production retro-reflectors; pass if no value is more than 20 per cent below the prescribed minimum values.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the minimum RI of retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the minimum RI over rotation at β1 = β2 = 0° and 20' divergence; pass if it is not below the paragraph 5 value.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI.
requirements.test_case: Rotate the unmarked retro-reflector about its reference axis at β1 = β2 = 0° and 20' divergence and identify the minimum RI position.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the RI of retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during the rotation about their axes ±5°.
requirements.test_case: Record RI throughout ±5° rotation; pass if no reading is below the prescribed value.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of retro-reflective devices of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector illuminating surface from 10 m; pass if its shape cannot be easily confused with the triangular shape prescribed for Class IIIA/IIIB.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.test_case: Store the moulded PMMA retro-reflector for 48 consecutive hours in a dry oven at 65 °C ± 2 °C and record the temperature log to confirm the condition was held.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector after the 65 °C/48 h heat test; pass if no cracking or appreciable distortion is visible, especially on the optical component.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.test_case: Remove all removable parts from the lamp/retro-reflector and immerse it for 10 min in water at 50 °C ± 5 °C with the top of the illuminating surface 20 mm below the water surface.

requirements.text: The water penetration test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.test_case: Repeat the 50 °C immersion with the device turned 180° so the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is under about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Immediately after the 50 °C immersions, immerse the device under the same conditions in water at 25 °C ± 5 °C and record the timing and temperature.

requirements.text: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.test_case: After the immersion sequence, visually inspect the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit; pass if no water is present.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect after immersion; record a fail if water is clearly visible on the reflecting surface.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.test_case: When no water is visible or in case of doubt, lightly shake off external water and measure the RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2; the device passes if it meets the specified RI values.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied to retro-reflective devices of the Classes IB and IIIB.
requirements.test_case: Confirm the test report applies both the moisture test and the dust test of Annex 6 Part 3 when the alternative is requested.

requirements.text: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF during the water spray test.
requirements.test_case: Verify the rear position, stop and reversing lamps are operated at design voltage in 5 min ON / 55 min OFF cycles during the spray test.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed in the device, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.test_case: Inspect, tap and tilt the device after draining; pass if no standing pool of water is present or forms.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the drain period, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.test_case: Dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth and measure RI per Annex 4 Part 1; record and compare with initial RI.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Clean and dry the exterior with a dry cotton cloth, measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 and compare with the initial RI.

requirements.text: Retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.
requirements.test_case: Perform the saline mist corrosion test per ISO 9227:2017 and Annex 6 Part 4; the photometric and colorimetric values measured afterwards must still meet the prescribed limits.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of retro-reflective devices to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.test_case: After the corrosion test, inspect the front surface for tarnishing and the rear face protection for deterioration; no impairment is permitted.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.test_case: Strip the lamp of removable parts and expose it to saline mist for 2 x 24 h with a 2 h drying interval between exposures; check the test log for compliance.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the sample immediately after the saline mist test; there must be no excessive corrosion liable to impair the device's efficiency.

requirements.text: After having brushed, in the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB and IVA, the rear face of the retro-reflective device, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute.
requirements.test_case: Apply a cotton cloth soaked in the Annex 7 Part 1 mixture to the brushed rear face for 1 minute, then let the device dry; verify this in the test log.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics mirror-backed reflectors as Classes IA and IB, the RI shall then be measured, according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, after the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face has been covered with Indian ink.
requirements.test_case: Cover the whole mirror-backed rear face with Indian ink and measure RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2.; the values must meet the prescribed requirements.

requirements.text: After being wiped with the test mixture, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.test_case: After the fuel wipe test, visual inspection of the retro-reflector shows no apparent surface changes other than slight surface cracks.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the retro-reflector outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in the n-heptane/toluol mixture, as the test condition.

requirements.text: After about five minutes, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually.
requirements.test_case: About five minutes after wiping with the test mixture, inspect the retro-reflector surface visually.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, after the lubricating oil test, the RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: After the oil wipe and cleaning, measure the CIL/RI per paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 and confirm it meets that paragraph's limits.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.test_case: Lightly wipe the moulded plastics retro-reflector outer and illuminating surface with a cotton cloth soaked in detergent lubricating oil, as the test condition.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, after about 5 minutes, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
requirements.test_case: Clean the retro-reflector surface about 5 minutes after the lubricating oil wipe.

requirements.text: The approval number shall be placed close to, but in any position in relation to, the circle surrounding the letter "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark on the retro-reflector; pass if the approval number is placed close to the circle surrounding the letter "E".

requirements.text: The digits constituting the approval number shall face the same way as the "E".
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark; pass if the digits of the approval number are oriented in the same direction as the letter "E".

requirements.text: The group of symbols indicating the class shall be diametrically opposite the approval number.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval mark; pass if the class symbol group (e.g. IA or IB) is positioned diametrically opposite the approval number relative to the circle.
